objective: Repair the Windows review findings: safe rg/fd invocation for specialists, PowerShell 5.1 probes, the installer secret leak and temp-file execution, and the doc claims.
scope: Blockers: (1) packages/runtime/src/instructions/claude-5.5/specialist/working.md: use bun --no-env-file --config="${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/empty-bunfig.toml" "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/holyagent.js" rg|fd ..., and add a test that every holyagent.js invocation in the instruction sources carries both flags; (2) install/windows-install.ps1 :127, :194, :215: native-command probes must not terminate under Windows PowerShell 5.1 with ErrorActionPreference Stop (run them with a local Continue preference or a helper), and guard the null node --version case.

Security fixes: windows-install.ps1:59 must not print arguments after --api-key (redact them); the Billion Context config script must not run from a predictable temp file (pipe it to node on stdin, or create it with a random name and CreateNew); escape single quotes in the profile lines (:188-189); make the profile-line regex ignore commented lines; match the PATH order comment to the code.
Docs: docs/hooks.md must not claim hooks 'fail visibly' if the host drops args (bun with no args prints help and exits 0) and must not show the hand-run form without flags at line 23.

Also carry two small instruction nits from the instructions review (they are on this branch through the merge): in packages/runtime/src/instructions/claude-5.5/root/asking.md change 'then list only those' to 'then ask only those through AskUserQuestion'; in root/user-messages.md say 'commit the Assignment paths you own with holyagent vcs commit' instead of 'committing work'.
Rebuild with mise run build and run mise run verify.
constraints: Work only in that worktree; make no version-control writes and no edits under .git/ or .holyagent/.
Keep working until done; when done and checked, stop and report; no unrequested changes. Name what still cannot be checked without Windows.
